summary: 手续费批准/成本与净额只读配对首片 on BASE e43c2c2. Added pmo_plugins/costing/bank_charge_pairing_services.py with two read-only interfaces. bank_charge_pairing(member, *, status=None, cash_transaction_id=None, as_of=None) returns visible BankCharge pairing projections: charge ref/status/version, posted incoming cash ref/status/direction/gross, fee gross/tax with tax_split_implemented=false, submitted/approved chain, the one-time cost claim coverage_key/amount, AccountingEvent refs and claim effects, LedgerPosting refs/amounts/book, derived net+approved-fee implied gross, refund/return coverage plus offset_implemented=false, PH-251 placeholders (receipt fee settlement, existing_cost_ref reuse, counterparty-borne, tax split all not_implemented), per-charge issues and pairing_state (draft/approved_unposted/posted/partial/paired/异常 with issues taking precedence). bank_charge_pairing_issues expands issue_code/charge_ref/refs/expected/actual for approved_without_cost, cost_event/cost_posting/cost_claim duplicates and amount mismatches, fee_exceeds_cash_gross, cash_not_posted_in, cross_org/cross_project references, unapproved_cost_posted and coverage_unavailable. Permissions are owner/finance/auditor full, PM only managed projects, member denied; the new history_read route bank-charge-pairing stays readable when costing is disabled and has no POST/write entry. The service writes nothing (no audit, receipt, event or fact) and adds no migration, canonical schema or costing write-path change; PH-251 fields are explicit placeholders rather than fabricated values. Gold: posted net cash 9800 + fee 200 draft->submit->independent approve->cost claim/event/posting 200 yields pairing_state posted, implied gross 10000, refund total 0 and issues=[]; anomaly fixtures use legal service transitions where possible and, for half-writes impossible through services (approved without cost, duplicate event, wrong posting amount, unapproved cost), a vendor-aware temporary trigger drop followed by INSERT only (no UPDATE/DELETE of history) so the append-only rule is preserved and PostgreSQL exercises the same test path.
